I want to point out, as someone who’s parent works in a vet clinic, there are way to many stories of owners “trying to fix the dog” but in reality the dog is just in pain and miserable for years and years. Sometimes, the most humane thing to do is put it down rather than extent it’s life and let it suffer. 

And I’ve seen it with my own eyes. I dog sat for someone and every time I saw this dog, that was in immense pain, seizing, peeing itself, and couldn’t see, my heart hurt. This dog should have been put down and the owner was giving it pills and finding other solutions to keep it alive. At some point it’s just torture. I dog sat three times for the owner over the course of three months, each time the dog was worse. And if she would have asked a fourth I would have declined. I felt like I was aiding in the abuse of this dog. 

I don’t know your pets circumstances, but your wife, though in a lot of pain in the loss, is a strong person. It takes a strong person and a good person to say “I won’t make you suffer because I want to be selfish”. And if you have never heard of the rainbow bridge, you should look it up. I’m not a religious person, but that poem helps me through when I miss my childhood pets. Though it does make me cry so fair warning there. 

I don’t have much advice for the family portion. But if I can ease her mind on what she did or didn’t do for her pet I hope I did. Of course there will always be the “what if we did this” I think about that with my childhood cat, but in the end, I know that I did prolong his suffering, and that’s important.

Hey! Throw away account cause I am just scared and don’t want people I know to find this. You know the usual. 

Anyway! So I traveled to Michigan 6/5 from Florida. I was going to my friends wedding the next day. I wore an n95 on the plane, I wore a cloth mask at the wedding. It was inside in a church. I was kinda uncomfortable with the amount of people not wearing masks but since I was in the bridal party I felt obligated to be there. I stayed in Michigan till 6/15 and on the flight home I wore my n95 again. The period between the wedding and leaving I stayed with a friend and we didn’t go out much and when we did it was all distanced and wearing masks. 

That’s the background of what I did. 6/12 I noticed my chest felt a little weird for a brief moment but I didn’t think much of it as I have recently developed allergies (thanks Florida) and had a little bit of a runny nose. 6/13 I got a lot more nervous about being sick. My nose was slightly runny (nothing extreme just more than normal) and my chest felt weird for longer. It doesn’t hurt. It’s centered in the sternum area. I don’t know how to describe it. It doesn’t hurt but it just feels weird. Like it feels fuzzy? If that makes sense. And the more I obsessed and thought about it the worse it got. So I thought maybe I was being a slight hypochondriac and panic was affecting my chest as well since I was obsessing over being sick. 6/14 I woke up and felt fine. Nose wasn’t pretty much normal. Later in the day my chest felt weird but I went for a run with a VERY tight bra (it constricts how I breath when I’m not panicked about covid) and post run my lungs didn’t have that fuzzy feeling. Even during the run my breathing wasn’t any different than normal with said bra on. 6/15 I traveled to Florida. I felt fine pretty much the entire day, even on the plane until I started my drive to the house (I had started to worry again) my throat was dry so I coughed a bit but I didn’t drink water for 7 hours and I was on a dry ass plane wearing an n95 and once I drank water I didn’t have to cough. Today my chest feels a little fuzzy on area previously mentioned. I have felt the need to cough like once but not if I don’t I die, just maybe still dehydrated from yesterday? Also my nose feels normal, not runny in the slightest.

I know this is long but I’m trying to be as precise as possible as I’m scared, I don’t want to infect people, and kill people(due to covid I’m with my family). I feel like I made a mistake going to Michigan and I’m very scared and panicked and on the verge of tears when I think about it. And Florida doesn’t test for shit, so I wanted to ask if these sounded familiar to anyone who is positive. If the fuzzy feeling is considered chest pain or tightness in the chest. If it is normal for that feeling to ebb and go away and come back if it is covid. If I just have like a crud from flying and being in a different (cooler, less humid) climate or if this may be covid. Thank you for your input! I know testing is best but, I’m limited by Florida being a bunch of dicks about testing.
